Method of Attack: Buffer overrun vulnerabilities triggered during X.509 certificate verification by supplying a specially-crafted email address
Impacted Systems: Linux operating systems (CentOS, Fedora, Kali, Linux Mint, openSUSE Leap, Ubuntu)
Container images built using affected Linux versions
Attack Vector: Connecting to a malicious server (TLS client)
Malicious client connecting to a server requesting client authentication (TLS server)

Method of Attack: Use-after-free bug that could result in a crash or execution of arbitrary code
Serious memory handling issue in the implementation of the TLS/DTLS heartbeat extension, enabling attackers to read portions of a target server's memory
Impacted Systems: 240,000 publicly accessible servers worldwide still vulnerable
